title: Line Counter workspace settings (.linecounter/settings.json)
description: Overrides the linecounter.* VS Code settings for this workspace. Keys may be written with or without the 'linecounter.' prefix.

enumDescriptions: Open the statistics page maximized (side bars and panel hidden).

Open the statistics page like a normal editor tab.

rant.commitWords.markdownDescription: Words or phrases in commit messages to rant about.
